Refined reusable environmental design candidate for the Hall of Blood, correcting only the captive's architectural scale while retaining the successful chamber baseline.

Retain the existing wide elevated establishing composition and the successful Hall of Blood architecture, but rescale M’uru substantially smaller so the naaru fits naturally inside the chamber's central containment zone. Preserve M’uru’s complete canonical silhouette and component arrangement at the reduced scale. Redirect the fixed crimson extraction beams so they converge accurately on the smaller captive. Reconstruct the space vacated by the oversized figure as coherent distant arches, columns, shadow, warm haze, and architectural depth matching the existing room. Keep the central dais, radial floor conduits, containment pylons, platforms, stairs, foreground columns, tiny attendants, viewpoint, and overall room layout intact. The chamber must remain the primary subject and M’uru a contained focal landmark within it.

Preserve the existing Hall of Blood's broad circular plan, elevated entrance viewpoint, foreground framing columns, red-black-gold Thalassian architecture, patterned ceiling, curved walls, pointed openings, raised platforms, central recessed dais, radial floor network, fixed pylons, navigable walkways, tiny scale figures, dark oppressive palette, and painterly Warcraft finish. Preserve the architectural scale established by the people and railings; do not enlarge those elements to compensate.

## Composition after edit
Same wide square establishing view and architectural framing as the source. The room remains dominant. Place the smaller M’uru on the central vertical axis just above the dais, with ample visible chamber volume around and above it. Binding beams form restrained diagonals from the existing pylons to the reduced captive. Maintain clear circulation paths and layered depth.

## Purposeful use of space after edit
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

Must change: Reduce M’uru to an environmental scale of only a few blood-elf heights, hover it low above the central dais, add localized containment beams, and replace the isolated portrait background with the existing Hall of Blood architecture.. This is a scale correction, not an architectural redesign. M’uru must be much smaller than in the source and visibly contained by the room. Do not replace the chamber, change the viewpoint, add a giant cage, add chains, or turn the scene into a shrine. No focal named characters, combat, readable text, labels, interface elements, logos, signatures, or watermarks. Keep an illustrated painterly finish rather than glossy 3D rendering.

Do not render words, letters, numbers, captions, labels, signatures, watermarks, logos, or story copy. Keep all story text as editable Lorekeeper text outside the raster image.

Make the requested revision as one coherent image. Preserve the explicitly listed continuity priorities, but do not freeze every unmentioned pixel or secondary detail. Allow nearby pose, framing, lighting, background, texture, and geometry to adapt naturally when needed to integrate the edit. Keep unrelated major subjects and story facts recognizable without duplicating, deforming, or partially reconstructing them.

images.altText: Centered painted portrait of M'uru, a radiant faceless naaru formed from symmetrical violet crystalline structures suspended around a brilliant white-gold and rose-magenta core in a dark atmospheric chamber.
images.prompt:
## Intended use
Exploratory isolated canonical-appearance candidate for M'uru, establishing the naaru's stable physical design in the same project art style as the approved Falanaras portrait.

## Scene and background
M'uru hovers alone in a neutral frontal presentation, fully visible from the upper halo to the lowest suspended crystal forms. Faithfully translate the complete naaru design visible in the supplied in-game screenshot into finished fantasy illustration without redesigning its silhouette or structural arrangement.

## Subjects
M'uru only: a luminous naaru composed of suspended crystalline and metallic-looking arcane forms around an intense central core.

## Appearance and continuity anchors
Recreate M'uru's visible design from the screenshot with maximum fidelity: preserve the complete symmetrical silhouette, relative proportions, orientation, spacing, layering, and number of the suspended components; the upper halo and crown structure; paired luminous nodes; central vertical elements; broad outward and lower swept crystalline forms; pointed outer structures; long lower suspended pieces; violet-lavender surfaces; and brilliant white, pale gold, rose-magenta, and violet Light. The subject has no humanoid face, flesh, clothing, armor, limbs, or added decorative redesign.

## Action
Hovering motionlessly in a calm neutral state, components suspended in ordered symmetry around the radiant core; no attack or active binding.

## Expression, pose, and gaze
Non-humanoid and faceless; solemn, tranquil, sacred presence. Exactly frontal orientation for clear design readability.

## Setting and environment
A subdued, nearly abstract dark chamber with deep charcoal, muted wine, and faint smoky amber atmosphere. Only restrained hints of tall Thalassian arches may dissolve into shadow; the setting must remain secondary and must not copy the screenshot's game environment.

## Style, medium, and palette
Match the approved Falanaras portrait's polished hand-painted Warcraft fantasy illustration: layered digital paint, visible broken brush texture, varied line and edge quality, selective crispness on focal forms, softer atmospheric transitions, richly modeled but not glossy 3D-rendered surfaces. Preserve M'uru's own luminous white-gold, rose-magenta, and violet palette against a dark warm-neutral field; do not transfer Falanaras's black-crimson armor design or humanoid features.

## Camera and framing
Square full-design portrait, straight-on eye-level equivalent, centered and symmetrical, with comfortable margin around every outer point and the complete lower forms visible.

## Composition
M'uru occupies the central vertical axis and most of the frame; clear readable silhouette, balanced negative space around the outer crystalline points, subtle atmospheric depth behind the glow. No text landing zone is needed.

## Purposeful use of space
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

## Lighting and mood
M'uru is the sole light source. Intense white-gold core, saturated rose-magenta radiance, violet translucency, soft colored bloom, and faint reflected light in the haze. Solemn, numinous, compassionate, and quietly sorrowful rather than aggressive.

## Reference image roles (actual provider input order)
Provider input image 1: authoritative canonical design reference for M'uru. Preserve: The exact visible naaru silhouette, component arrangement, symmetry, proportions, spacing, suspended structure, upper halo, central core, paired luminous nodes, crystalline forms, and white-gold, rose-magenta, violet luminosity.. Must change: Remove the in-game screenshot rendering, pixelation, interface text, red binding beams, prison apparatus, and background. Present M'uru alone in a calm neutral state.. Image id: 797612f9-cf31-443c-a2b8-51ef026edfd5.
Provider input image 2: approved project rendering-language reference only. Preserve: Polished hand-painted Warcraft fantasy finish, layered digital brushwork, visible color breakup, varied edges, selective crisp detail, dark atmospheric presentation, and rich but non-photoreal modeling.. Must change: Do not copy Falanaras, his anatomy, pose, armor, sword, heraldry, faceguard, palette distribution, or architecture. Replace the humanoid portrait with the screenshot-faithful non-humanoid M'uru design.. Image id: a22d39de-1219-4f9b-8475-2aab8132460d.

## Constraints and exclusions
Use the screenshot as the authoritative design reference and the approved Falanaras portrait only as the rendering-style reference. Preserve screenshot-faithful structure rather than inventing a generic angel, crystal golem, armored humanoid, or mechanical robot. No chains, red binding beams, prison pylons, captors, interface elements, labels, readable text, signature, or watermark. Keep the full silhouette uncropped and clearly separated from the background.

## Creative latitude
Meet every stated story, continuity, composition, and output requirement. Freely compose visual details that are not prescribed by the brief or references so the result feels intentional and coherent. Do not infer that unspecified details are forbidden, and do not add literal exclusions such as 'nothing else'.

## Rendered-text policy
Do not render words, letters, numbers, captions, labels, signatures, watermarks, logos, or story copy. Keep all story text as editable Lorekeeper text outside the raster image.

## Output target and protected regions
Raster size: 1024x1024. Aspect ratio: 1:1.

images.altText: Close painterly scene in the Hall of Blood showing an unarmed Falanaras in black-and-crimson armor gazing in quiet awe at the captive violet naaru M’uru, whose purple-white light washes across his face and armor amid crimson containment pylons.
images.prompt:
## Intended use
Exploratory narrative key-art concept combining the approved Falanaras, M’uru, and Hall of Blood baselines ahead of later cover-format iterations; free-standing project-library art, not final cover layout.

## Scene and background
Inside the Hall of Blood, Falanaras stands at close range before the captive naaru M’uru. He has just confronted the sacred being held within the crimson containment apparatus and looks on in arrested, reverent awe as its purple-white radiance illuminates him.

## Subjects
Falanaras, the adult male blood elf protagonist in his canonical black-and-crimson Blood Knight armor, without any weapon; M’uru, the canonical faceless violet crystalline naaru suspended within the Hall of Blood containment dais; the Hall of Blood’s red-black-gold Thalassian chamber and nearby extraction apparatus.

## Appearance and continuity anchors
Preserve Falanaras’s canonical identity and armor faithfully: pale angular blood-elf face, vivid green eyes, white-blond high ponytail, long front locks, swept ears, compact open crimson faceguard with the approved shortened central point, fitted black armor with restrained crimson edges, moderate pauldrons, dark tabard with large crimson phoenix, red waist gemstone, gauntlets and layered armor. Remove the sword entirely and do not add a scabbard. Preserve M’uru’s canonical faceless suspended silhouette, violet crystalline components, white-gold core, rose-magenta and violet radiance. Preserve the Hall of Blood’s curved red-black architecture, tarnished-gold trim, pointed arches, dark columns, circular containment dais, radial conduits, and crimson extraction pylons.

## Action
Falanaras stands still several paces from M’uru, hands relaxed and empty at his sides, body turned toward the captive as he absorbs the sight. M’uru hovers within the active containment field; restrained crimson beams and conduits hold it in place.

## Expression, pose, and gaze
Show Falanaras from a front three-quarter angle so both his expression and his gaze toward M’uru are unmistakable. His posture is upright but momentarily unguarded, shoulders lowered, lips slightly parted, eyes widened with quiet awe, sorrow, and moral unease rather than theatrical shock. He looks directly at M’uru. No combat stance.

## Setting and environment
A close section of the underground Hall of Blood around the central containment dais. Curved crimson-black columns, pointed Thalassian arches, gold-edged dark stone, red conduits, and one or two nearby extraction pylons establish the room. Keep distant architecture softened in haze; the framing is intimate rather than a full-room establishing view.

## Style, medium, and palette
Polished hand-painted Warcraft fantasy illustration matching the approved project images: layered digital paint, visible broken brushwork and color breakup, varied hard and soft edges, selective crisp detail on Falanaras’s face, armor heraldry, and M’uru’s core, atmospheric softness elsewhere, richly modeled but not glossy or photoreal. Deep wine, charcoal, black, tarnished gold, and crimson chamber tones are transformed by M’uru’s violet, magenta, lavender, and white-gold illumination.

## Camera and framing
Square narrative key art, close low-to-eye-level camera, Falanaras shown approximately thigh-up in the near foreground from a front three-quarter angle, occupying one side of the composition. M’uru hovers in the near midground on the opposing side, fully identifiable and within the established scale of only a few blood-elf heights. Avoid wide-room distance and avoid extreme perspective distortion.

## Composition
Create an intimate visual exchange between Falanaras and M’uru. Falanaras is the emotional focal point and M’uru the luminous sacred focal point; their gaze/energy line carries the image diagonally. Keep enough of the containment dais, a pylon, and an arch visible to identify the Hall of Blood. Preserve plausible distance and scale between them. Let upper peripheral shadow and atmospheric architecture remain relatively quiet for future flexible cropping, while all other areas contribute to light, depth, containment, or emotional focus.

## Purposeful use of space
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

## Lighting and mood
M’uru is the dominant light source, casting strong lavender, violet, rose, and white-gold illumination across the side and front planes of Falanaras’s face, pale hair, compact faceguard, black armor, crimson edges, phoenix emblem, and empty gauntlets. Crimson apparatus light remains a weaker counterlight from below and behind. Mood is numinous, intimate, morally unsettling, sorrowful, and awe-struck; the Light feels beautiful, captive, and painful.

## Reference image roles (actual provider input order)
Provider input image 1: canonical identity and default Blood Knight armor for Falanaras. Preserve: Falanaras’s face, pale complexion, green eyes, white-blond ponytail and front locks, ears, compact open crimson faceguard with shortened point, black-crimson armor construction, moderate silhouette, phoenix heraldry, red waist gem, and painterly finish.. Must change: Replace the frontal neutral full-body pose with an intimate front three-quarter thigh-up pose looking toward M’uru; remove the sword completely; change the expression to quiet awe and moral unease; replace warm frontal chamber light with strong purple-white illumination from M’uru.. Image id: a22d39de-1219-4f9b-8475-2aab8132460d.
Provider input image 2: canonical identity for M’uru. Preserve: M’uru’s complete faceless naaru silhouette, suspended symmetrical violet crystalline components, white-gold central core, rose-magenta and violet radiance, and sacred painterly presence.. Must change: Place M’uru within the active Hall of Blood containment apparatus at environmental scale, seen from Falanaras’s nearby viewpoint rather than as an isolated frontal portrait; add restrained crimson extraction beams and room lighting integration.. Image id: b0aa92d9-7b93-42ce-9c68-8788b0f9aaa2.
Provider input image 3: canonical Hall of Blood architecture, containment layout, palette, and scale. Preserve: Curved red-black-gold Thalassian architecture, pointed arches, dark columns, central circular dais, radial red conduits, crimson pylons, oppressive chamber palette, and corrected M’uru-to-room scale.. Must change: Move from the wide elevated establishing view to a close intimate eye-level composition near the dais; simplify and soften distant architecture; introduce canonical Falanaras in the foreground and make M’uru’s purple light dominate his illumination.. Image id: 2b49ee60-0ab2-419f-a071-1cd7935bd374.

## Constraints and exclusions
Maintain the canonical identities and established architectural scale. Falanaras has no sword, weapon, shield, scabbard, or combat action. Do not enlarge M’uru into a chamber-filling monument; use camera proximity and illumination to create presence. Do not turn M’uru humanoid, angelic, winged, or facial. Do not redesign Falanaras’s armor or faceguard. Keep the containment system visible but do not bury either focal subject under excessive beams or bloom. No other focal characters. No readable text, title, logo, signature, watermark, or game interface.

## Creative latitude
Meet every stated story, continuity, composition, and output requirement. Freely compose visual details that are not prescribed by the brief or references so the result feels intentional and coherent. Do not infer that unspecified details are forbidden, and do not add literal exclusions such as 'nothing else'.

## Rendered-text policy
Do not render words, letters, numbers, captions, labels, signatures, watermarks, logos, or story copy. Keep all story text as editable Lorekeeper text outside the raster image.

## Output target and protected regions
Raster size: 1024x1024. Aspect ratio: 1:1.
